text:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER — high-sev incident: multiple jobs in tp4-runner pool reporting NCCL hangs and one container crash; error rate spike > 80% in the last 5m. Page to oncall @maria :rotating_light:

maria: I'm oncall, grabbing the bridge. Anyone with context on running models? Which pool? I'll gather initial impact.

aj_kim: tp4-runner pool. nodes: gpu-worker-12, gpu-worker-13, gpu-worker-14. Seeing repeated `NCCL WARN` and then a container exit with `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation` in logs on worker-13.

simon: confirming logs. snippet from runner logs:
```
[2026-03-15 09:42:11] NCCL WARN Call to cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2026-03-15 09:42:11] NCCL INFO comm 0x7f8e1a created
[2026-03-15 09:42:12] NCCL ERROR Unhandled send/recv error during allreduce
[2026-03-15 09:42:12] Process killed by signal 6 (Aborted) pid=21345
```

devon: also seeing kernel messages from node:
```
Mar 15 09:42:12 gpu-worker-13 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:0a:00): 79, pid=21345, Ch 0000008f, ...
Mar 15 09:42:12 gpu-worker-13 dockerd[1234]: container runtime: container exited with status 134
```

maria: @aj_kim please run `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep gpu-worker-13` and paste affected pod ids. Marking node as suspected.

aj_kim: pod ids: `inference/tp-infer-abc123`, `inference/tp-infer-def456` (both on gpu-worker-13). Both showing CrashLoopBackOff. `kubectl describe pod tp-infer-abc123` shows `OOMKilled` then `Killed`.

infra-bot: AUTO-ANNOTATION — node gpu-worker-13 shows GPU memory pressure > 95% across all GPUs; nvtop snapshot attached (link omitted).

simon: Quick mitigation suggestion: cordon + drain gpu-worker-13 to move active pipeline-parallel shards. But draining will kill pods mid-collective which risks longer hangs. We can try scaling pool down and fallback to single-gpu variant for live traffic.

maria: Agree. Plan: 1) scale target model replicas to 0 on worker-13 via nodeSelector override; 2) enable `inference.fallback.single_gpu=true` for public route to accept slightly higher latency; 3) cordon gpu-worker-13 and evict. Doing step 2 first.

aj_kim: toggled feature flag `inference.fallback.single_gpu=true` on edge-router ; route now using fallback model variant. Traffic rerouted — error rate dropping from 82% -> 18%.

julie: Noted customer impact: customers A & C on dedicated capacity reported increase in 5xxs. Sending status -> sev2. Will prepare customer-facing blurb.

maria: Cordoning node now: `kubectl cordon gpu-worker-13` -> `node/gpu-worker-13 cordoned`.

maria: Starting drain: `kubectl drain gpu-worker-13 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=30` — evictions beginning. Will watch NCCL leader election.

simon: While draining, we saw one pod stuck in terminating; logs show `ncclCommInitRank failed: unhandled system error` repeatedly. I'm going to force delete that pod to break the hang.

aj_kim: Force deleting pod `tp-infer-abc123` done. New replica scheduled on gpu-worker-14 — started successfully.

devon: Observability: per-token latency up 20% on fallback but throughput stable. No more Xid79s after eviction started. GPU memory on other nodes back to normal.

infra-bot: NOTE: kubelet reported `eviction threshold met` on gpu-worker-13 due to GPU memory leak in container `model-runtime:v2.3.1`.

maria: Root cause hypothesis: model-runtime v2.3.1 has a memory leak during large tensor collective init under tp4 config. It triggered OOM on one container, which caused NCCL communicator instability across the job and then other GPUs experienced timeouts.

simon: Repro steps (local): run tp4 with batch=32 and pipeline-parallel=4 on large-seq config -> nvtx shows memory growth per step, reproduces Xid 79 within ~100 iterations. Filing ticket to lock v2.3.1 rollback.

maria: Remediation actions:
- rollback model-runtime to v2.3.0 for tp4-runner stateless pool
- create canary deploy of v2.3.0 on gpu-worker-14 only
- patch autoscaler to avoid packing >1 large-tp job per node
- add OOM monitoring alert for GPU memory leaks

aj_kim: Kicking rollback: updating deployment image -> `model-runtime:v2.3.0` for tp4-runner. Canary scheduling shows one replica on gpu-worker-14; tests pass.

julie: Notifying impacted customers with a short summary and ETA for full remediation. Will post update in 30m.

maria: After rollback, traffic metrics back to normal. Closing the page if no regressions in 15m. Leaving node gpu-worker-13 cordoned for deeper postmortem.

devon: Postmortem notes to include: exact NCCL error strings, container stack traces, kernel Xid logs, scheduling decisions that allowed packing, and a proposed autoscaler patch.

simon: Assigning follow-ups: #INC-4521 rollback verification (aj_kim), #INC-4522 autoscaler patch (devon), #INC-4523 model-runtime memory audit (research team).

maria: Thanks team. I'll hand off to oncall rotation for post-incident tracking. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty-bot: RESOLVE — Incident acknowledged resolved by oncall at 2026-03-15T09:58:40Z. If anything flares, re-open and page again.
